verified_contracts: the 1m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England and represents terrain with surface objects removed
the composite combines time-stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat coverage uses the newest best-resolution survey available
resampled data uses bilinear interpolation before merging
survey metadata catalogues identify which survey contributed at a location
GeoTIFF rasters are supplied in 5km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid
values are in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn using OSTN15 for the composite
individual surveys contributing to the composite have plus-or-minus 15cm RMSE vertical accuracy
the coordinate reference system is EPSG 27700
time-stamped DTM data may be 25cm, 50cm, 1m or 2m and uses survey-specific transformation and geoidal models
DSM products include objects such as buildings, vegetation and vehicles and are not interchangeable with bare-earth DTM
WCS supplies elevation coverages while WMS is a visualised or summarised map service
